Please use a different style for the final `$status` in `pipestatus_format`

                pipestatus = true

body:
We leave `None` defaults empty, because TOML doesn't have any equivalent.
```suggestion
| `pipestatus_segment_format` |                                                                        | When specified, replaces `format` when formatting pipestatus segments |
```

This is much simpler:
```suggestion
    let segment_format = config.pipestatus_segment_format.unwrap_or(config.format);
```
